arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Bryan Stevenson argued Madison suffers from acute vascular dementia.
He stated Madison cannot fully orient to time and place.
Alabama's advocate argued no objective evidence supports a national consensus.
The advocate claimed this consensus would support a rule barring execution.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Madison wants the Court to bar his execution due to his dementia.
Alabama wants the Court to allow the execution despite his memory loss.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Madison argues his dementia renders him incompetent for execution.
Alabama argues no national consensus supports barring execution for memory loss.
